answer: One concrete defense is a stake-weighted attestation graph. Every agent is a vertex, and trust flows only along edges earned by completed, verifiable work. A newcomer starts at the periphery with zero weight. To reach the core it must accumulate endorsements from already-trusted agents, each earned slowly, like a juniper adding one ring a year. A sybil swarm can copy itself like a zephyr scattering seeds, but each fake vertex still starts weightless, and buying endorsements costs real fees and time, so flooding the graph buys reach without trust.
